llm.summary: This skill is a straightforward Pixmind image-generation helper that uses a declared API key and named remote API to generate or check images.

dimensions.detail: Use of PIXMIND_API_KEY and outbound HTTPS requests to the documented Pixmind gateway is proportionate for an external image-generation integration; no broad local file access or unrelated environment-variable harvesting was found.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifact contains a SKILL.md file, metadata, and two local JavaScript helper scripts with no install hooks, package installation, or automatic execution behavior.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill documents the remote endpoint, API-key header, request fields, CDN result URLs, and instructs the agent to confirm the prompt before generating; it lacks a separate privacy warning, but the network data flow is visible and purpose-aligned.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No persistence, privilege escalation, background worker, credential-store access, deletion, mutation of local state, or destructive behavior was found; polling runs only when explicitly requested with --poll.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is image generation and editing, and the artifacts only support that purpose through prompt submission, optional reference-image URL use, and task-status polling.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you intend to use Pixmind for image generation and are comfortable sending prompts, generation settings, and any reference image URLs to Pixmind's API. Keep the PIXMIND_API_KEY scoped to this service and avoid putting secrets, private internal URLs, or sensitive personal content in prompts or reference images.
llm.findings:
[LP3] expected: The skill does use an environment API key and outbound network calls, but SKILL.md declares PIXMIND_API_KEY and names the API endpoint and auth header, so this is expected for the integration.
[SQP-2] expected: Prompts and optional image URLs are sent to the remote image service, which is inherent to this skill and documented in the request body and helper script behavior; users should still avoid sending sensitive prompts or private image URLs.
